ranked.headline: Deep learning models for single-cell regulatory inference, annotation, and benchmarking
ranked.summary: Foundation models and interpretable architectures are now benchmarked against established single-cell and regulatory inference methods.

ranked.headline: Learned models integrate spatial, imaging and multi-omics single-cell data across…
ranked.summary: Spatial and multi-omics datasets now span platforms and gene panels, demanding integration methods that tolerate missing shared features and modality mismatch.

ranked.headline: Algorithms for variant, haplotype, and tandem repeat inference from sequencing data
ranked.summary: New statistical and index-based methods target SNPs, haplotypes, and repeat copy number from long and short reads.

ranked.headline: Statistical correction of sequencing count data for zeros, scale, and batch effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers address zero handling, scale misspecification, and batch harmonization across RNA-seq, microbiome, and proteomics data.

ranked.headline: Throughput-focused tools speed up sequencing, interval, and single-cell analyses
ranked.summary: Recent releases target throughput limits in single-cell, sequencing, and genomic interval workloads on large datasets and mixed hardware.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer cell states, composition and regulators from omics data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs interpretable optimization and factorization methods with physics-informed models for single-cell and bulk omics data.

ranked.headline: Web tools pair multi-omics data with machine learning for biomarker and target discovery
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint tools extend web-accessible multi-omics analysis to biomarker panels, drug target nomination, and causal gene prioritization.

ranked.headline: Identifiability and coupling limits in dynamic models of microbial community dynamics
ranked.summary: Microbial community models now face identifiability and coupling-threshold tests, with preprints extending inference checks to other dynamical systems.

ranked.headline: Truth-anchored benchmarks expose variant calling variability across classes and platforms
ranked.summary: Reference-based benchmarks now test SV callers, targeted NGS pipelines, and long-read transcript quantification against known truth.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generators are reshaping protein design and complex docking
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple co-folding predictors and synthetic structure-sequence pairs to train generative protein design and docking models.

ranked.headline: Computational models quantitatively tested against human brain and neural recordings
ranked.summary: LLM representations, whole-brain simulations, and EEG metrics are now scored directly against neural recordings across scales.

ranked.headline: Deep models fuse multiomic and single-cell data for cancer and cell-state prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair graph, contrastive, and foundation architectures with multi-layer molecular profiles for cancer prediction and interpretation.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for pangenome graphs, synteny, phylogenetic traits, and 13C flux
ranked.summary: Recent software releases extend pangenome graph manipulation, synteny preprocessing, phylogenetic trait labeling, and isotope-resolved metabolic flux analysis.

ranked.headline: Computational models prioritize ligands and hits ahead of experimental testing
ranked.summary: Experimentally validated prioritization of hits and blind head-to-head benchmarks now test whether model-driven ranking generalizes beyond retrospective…

ranked.headline: Compact indexes and k-mer methods accelerate bacterial sequence classification
ranked.summary: Compact representations and automated workflows make reference-based classification of plasmid, 16S, and metagenomic reads tractable at scale.

ranked.headline: Computational models probe Pol II CTD phosphorylation and chromatin compartments
ranked.summary: Quantitative and machine-learning models now resolve Pol II behavior, condensate formation, and chromatin compartments from genomic data.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and deep learning methods refine variant prioritization in genetic association
ranked.summary: Recent methods address regulatory variant scoring, missing genotypes, multitrait gene-level effects and rare-variant aggregation in association studies.

ranked.headline: Spatial single-cell data constrain physics-based and mechanistic models of tumor tissue
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell measurements now inform mechanistic and physics-driven models, moving beyond correlational readouts of tissue organization.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks guide large-scale molecular similarity, clustering, and stability prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark or consolidate computational tools for clustering, flexibility, gene cluster similarity, and ddG prediction.

ranked.headline: Generative and physics-based sampling of protein conformational dynamics
ranked.summary: Generative ensembles and NMR-validated excited states now expose transition paths and sparse conformers that single structures miss.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for proteoform, spectral, and protein fold analysis
ranked.summary: Recent computational tools address proteoform cataloging, spectral variant search, fold-switching prediction, and miniprotein characterization.

ranked.headline: Learned models span docking selection, causal cell networks, and relation extraction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply learned embeddings, causal discovery, and LLM feature curation to biomedical prediction and extraction tasks.

ranked.headline: Privacy-preserving methods target GWAS statistics, synthetic genomes and haplotype phasing
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 work addresses privacy constraints on releasing GWAS statistics, generating synthetic genomes, and phasing haplotypes from private data.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned generative models now design RNAs, proteins, and ligands
ranked.summary: Generative models conditioned on 3D structure, binding-site dynamics, or energy landscapes are now being validated for designing RNAs, ligands, and proteins.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised and meta-learning models decode neural, imaging, and clinical data
ranked.summary: Self-supervised and meta-learning architectures now target neuron identity, medical imaging, and Alzheimer's diagnosis from multimodal data.

ranked.headline: Neural ODEs and foundation models predict microbial dynamics and drug interactions
ranked.summary: Learned models now link gut microbiome dynamics under antibiotics to bloodstream infection risk and infer microbe-drug associations.

ranked.headline: Compositional and transformer-based molecular features improve disease risk prediction
ranked.summary: Derived molecular representations from proteomics, metabolomics, and transcriptomics are being tested as biomarkers for early, multi-disease risk prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep learning sharpens variant, peptide and TCR binding prediction from sequence
ranked.summary: Sequence-based deep models are now applied to variant effect prediction, MHC and TCR binding, and unsupervised viral variant detection in wastewater reads.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve binding-induced conformational shifts in MHC, GPCR and receptors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply all-atom and steered MD to HLA-B*51, TAS2R14 and neurotrophin receptors, linking dynamics to binding and glycosylation effects.

ranked.headline: Sequence models predict immune receptor-antigen recognition and affinity maturation
ranked.summary: Fresh head-to-head benchmarks and validated epitope and affinity predictors now test which sequence-based models best capture immune receptor recognition.

ranked.headline: Amplitude-equation and reaction-network models tune gene-circuit patterns and responses
ranked.summary: Reduced models now specify how genetic circuits and receptor systems can be controlled for pattern formation, perceptron-like computation, and ligand…

ranked.headline: Computational enzyme design scaffolds catalytic sites from atom-level functional group…
ranked.summary: Hybrid ML and deep generative methods now scaffold enzyme active sites directly from atom-level geometry, with RFdiffusion2 handling all 41 benchmark sites.

ranked.headline: Software tools standardize glycan nomenclatures, interface analysis, and nanobody data
ranked.summary: Three 2025 published tools target glycan nomenclature interoperability, atomic interface analysis, and nanobody data management.

ranked.headline: Telomere-to-telomere and long-read assemblies resolve complex loci across three species
ranked.summary: Complete long-read and telomere-to-telomere assemblies now resolve coding-region and Y-linked loci in mouse, fruit fly and pest genomes.

ranked.headline: Genomic deep learning models harbor confounders and blind spots in splicing
ranked.summary: Interpretability, leakage-free benchmarking, and robustness to missing data are being applied to genomic machine learning models.

ranked.headline: Imperfect detection and chromatin-coupled bursting reshape inferred single-cell kinetics
ranked.summary: Imperfect single-cell detection and chromatin-state coupling both alter how kinetic parameters are read from single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Statistical and optical-mapping methods infer genome structure and selection effects
ranked.summary: New computational methods extract karyotypes, fetal survival effects, and repeat-locus selection from existing optical-map and cohort data.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link field stimulation and sensory context to neuronal response
ranked.summary: Realistic geometry and mechanistic decomposition are now applied to dose optimization, ephaptic coupling, and visual-spatial separation in neural tissue.
